definitions.explanation: Medicine or remedy used to suppress or relieve coughing.

examples.japanese: {薬局|やっきょく}で{咳止|せきど}めを{買|か}ってきて。
examples.english: Go buy some cough medicine at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: この{咳止|せきど}めシロップは{子供|こども}でも{飲|の}みやすい。
examples.english: This cough syrup is easy even for children to take.

notes:
A compound of {咳|せき} (cough) and {止|と}め (stopping), referring to medicine that suppresses coughing. Can refer to cough drops, syrups, or tablets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {咳止|せきど}めを{飲|の}む — to take cough medicine
- {咳止|せきど}めシロップ — cough syrup
- {咳止|せきど}めの{薬|くすり} — cough medicine
- {咳止|せきど}めドロップ — cough drops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {風邪薬|かぜぐすり} — cold medicine (broader; treats multiple cold symptoms, not just cough)
- {鎮咳剤|ちんがいざい} — antitussive (medical/technical term for cough suppressant)
